question: Show all customers from Germany
sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, city FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany' ORDER BY customer_id

question: List the 10 most expensive products
sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC, product_id LIMIT 10

question: Which products are currently inactive?
sql: SELECT product_id, name FROM products WHERE is_active = 0 ORDER BY product_id

question: Show orders that were returned
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned' ORDER BY order_id

question: What product categories do we have?
sql: SELECT category_id, name FROM categories ORDER BY category_id

question: List suppliers based in China
sql: SELECT supplier_id, name, lead_time_days FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'China' ORDER BY supplier_id

question: How many customers are there in each country?
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC, country

question: What is the average product price?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products

question: What is the total revenue across all orders?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'

question: What is the average order value by customer segment?
sql: SELECT c.segment, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

question: How many orders are there for each status?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC, status

question: What is the total quantity sold per product category?
sql: SELECT cat.name AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, category

question: Top 5 suppliers by number of products
sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name ORDER BY product_count DESC, s.name LIMIT 5

question: How much money was collected by each payment method?
sql: SELECT method, SUM(amount) AS collected FROM payments WHERE status = 'captured' GROUP BY method ORDER BY collected DESC

question: What is the average review rating for each product category?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

question: Which 5 products generated the most revenue?
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.line_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show the 20 most recent orders with customer names
sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC LIMIT 20

question: Which products belong to the Electronics category?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.unit_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics' ORDER BY p.product_id

question: List the products supplied by Japanese suppliers
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, s.name AS supplier FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE s.country = 'Japan' ORDER BY p.product_id

question: Show the 15 latest reviews with product name and rating
sql: SELECT r.review_id, p.name AS product, r.rating, r.review_date FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id ORDER BY r.review_date DESC, r.review_id DESC LIMIT 15

question: Which carrier shipped order 1000 and who is the customer?
sql: SELECT s.carrier, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE s.order_id = 1000

question: List the line items of order 42 with product names
sql: SELECT oi.order_item_id, p.name, oi.quantity, oi.line_total FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 42 ORDER BY oi.order_item_id

question: Which customers have left a 1-star review?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM reviews r JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE r.rating = 1 ORDER BY c.customer_id

question: What payment method was used on the 10 biggest orders?
sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.total_amount, p.method FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC, o.order_id LIMIT 10

question: Show total revenue by month in 2025
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Who were the top 5 customers by revenue last quarter?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 5

question: How many new customers signed up in 2024?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < '2025-01-01'

question: What is the average delivery time in days for each carrier?
sql: SELECT carrier, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_date) - julianday(shipped_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM shipments WHERE delivered_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY carrier

question: How many orders were placed in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date('2025-12-31', '-30 days')

question: What was our revenue for each year?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS year, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Which month of 2024 had the most orders?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have not placed an order since the start of 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS inactive_customers FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01')

question: How many reviews were written each month of 2025?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', review_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews WHERE review_date >= '2025-01-01' AND review_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: What was the revenue in each quarter of 2024?
sql: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS quarter, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter
